A validation report answers detailed questions: which checks failed, on how many rows, and at what
severity. It does not directly answer the question a manager or a dashboard usually asks first,
which is how healthy the data is overall and where it is weakest. Data quality scoring answers that.
It combines the step results into a few scores, one for each of several quality dimensions and one
overall, so you can describe a table's condition with a number and track it over time.
